content: It does not matter how slowly you go as long as you do not stop.
author: Confucius
explanation: Confucius emphasizes that true character and mastery are not built through erratic bursts of speed, but through steady, unyielding momentum. In the cultivation of virtue and skill, consistency always overcomes raw speed.
practicalInsight: Focus on showing up and advancing your core objective by a single millimeter today rather than burning out from overambition.
reflectionPrompt: Where in your life have you felt discouraged by slow progress, and how can you honor the value of patient persistence?
